The '''Slippery Slopes Cantina''', also known as '''Headbutt Hari's cantina''', was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] owned by [[Hari]] that was located in the [[Promenade]] shopping complex on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Within the cantina was the [[Roughneck Room]].
